text:
alyssa: Kicked off k-fold bringup for mandrake embeddings (ONNX int8 vs fp16 baseline). Quick summary: recall@1/5/10 down ~0.6%/0.3%/0.1% on short queries vs fp16, but long-tail behaviour looks different.

michael: Which dataset and holdout split?

alyssa: holdout-v2 (1M vectors, 10k eval queries). Used Faiss HNSW index, batch=256 for embedding extraction.

ci-bot: CI run finished: mandrake-onnx-int8 -> recall@1 0.842, @5 0.921, @10 0.941. baseline fp16 -> 0.848 / 0.924 / 0.945. diffs -0.006 / -0.003 / -0.004. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/mandrake/6523456789

rami: UMAP dump looks like a tiny cluster drift for multi-sentence examples, some anchors shifted between neighboring clusters: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/umap/6523456789.png

eva: Can you paste the exact eval commands + quant params?

alyssa: Eval snippet: 
```
python eval/recall.py --index hnsw --metric cosine --dataset holdout-v2 --k 10 --batch 256
python quant/convert.py --backend onnx --mode perchannel --bits 8
```

michael: Did you try inner_product? scale differences between quantized and fp can be masked by IP vs cosine.

alyssa: Tried IP: recall@1 +0.004 on short queries but long-tail (rare phrases) dropped ~0.7%. so IP helps head, hurts tail.

ci-bot: Regression alert created: RG-6523 (linked to ticket ML-1228).

rami: Hypothesis: PQ-like distortions vs per-channel int8. Suggest running int6 per-channel and int8 per-tensor as comparators. Also try ONNX QDQ flow vs our current quant tool.

eva: Also add cluster-level metrics: silhouette and cluster purity. Preliminary: silhouette dropped 0.62 -> 0.57 for mandrake-int8 on holdout-v2.

alyssa: Plan: run kfold(5) matrix for {metric: cosine, inner_product} x {quant: int8-perchannel, int8-pertensor, int6-perchannel} x {index: hnsw, ivf_pq} and produce recall@k + silhouette + sample error cases. Will kick off overnight and post results tomorrow. Assigning to @rami @eva. :thumbsup:

michael: ack. If int6 looks promising, also try fused QAT trick from the last experiment (scale calibration).

sre-bot: Deploy note: do not route prod traffic to mandrake-onnx-int8 until rollout policy is defined in Console (canary + automatic fallback to fp16). Create a canary config if we want fast, reversible rollouts.

eva: Add a 100-query prompt-based semantic check (hand-curated) to catch semantic flips that recall metrics miss.

alyssa: Thanks — will update thread with kfold table + top-20 failure cases.
